title: Private VLAN Basics
description: Understand primary, secondary (isolated & community) VLANs and how to isolate hosts within a VLAN.
scenario: Understand primary, secondary (isolated & community) VLANs and how to isolate hosts within a VLAN.

concepts.title: What is a Private VLAN?
concepts.body: A private VLAN (PVLAN) turns one broadcast domain (primary VLAN) into multiple isolated (sec) sub-domains. Hosts within a set of secondary VLANs can be isolated or grouped.
concepts.code:
Primary VLAN 100
  → Isolated VLAN 101 (hosts cannot → each other)
  → Community VLAN 102 (hosts can talk)

concepts.title: Primary & Secondary VLANs
concepts.body: The primary VLAN is the overall broadcast domain. An "isolated" VLAN means hosts reach only the promiscuous port. "community" VLANs let the group communicate among itself.
concepts.code:
Primary: carries promiscuous port traffic
Isolated: hosts cannot peers — only promiscuous
Community: peers inside the group can chat

concepts.title: Basic Configuration
concepts.body: Configure the primary and secondary VLAN kinds, then associate them.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# vlan 100
SW1(config-vlan)# private-vlan primary
SW1(config)# vlan 101
SW1(config-vlan)# private-vlan isolated
SW1(config-vlan)# private-vlan association 101

concepts.title: Verifying Private VLANs
concepts.body: "show vlan private-vlan" shows the primary/secondary association table.
concepts.code:
SW1# show vlan private-vlan
Primary  Secondary  Ports
100      101 (iso)  ...
100      102 (com)  ...
